fields.place: Kāmyavana (Vraja); Bhāṇḍīravana (Birbhum); Maṅgaladihi (Birbhum); pilgrimage to Purī
fields.notes: A sannyāsī of Kāmyavana who, fleeing the Muslims, brought the Deities Śrī Śyāmacāṅd and Balarāma and twelve Gopālas to Bengal. Left Bhāṇḍīravana after the killing of a brāhmaṇa cook at his āśrama; gave the twelfth Gopāla to a beggar brāhmaṇa at the Mayūrākṣī (later installed at Bhāṇḍīravana); at Maṅgaladihi left Śyāmacāṅd and Balarāma with his friend Gopāla, son of Mansukha, and when he tried to take Them back the Lord told him in a dream to return Him there. Told in Jagadānanda's Śrī Śyāmacandrodaya (#1985) and the Vīrabhūma-vivaraṇa.

fields.disappearance: The night after the Vaiśākha ekādaśī, 1300 BS (1893) (the record's text)
fields.place: Udhumā (Pabna); the royal estate of Kākinā
fields.guru: Vaikuṇṭha Gosvāmī of Mahiṣāḍerā (Nadia), of Advaita Prabhu's family (dīkṣā)
fields.notes: Of a Vārendra kāyastha family of Udhumā (Pabna); left a high post in the Kākinā estate; dīkṣā from Vaikuṇṭha Gosvāmī of Advaita's family. When his only son Śyāmasundara died he went on with kīrtana; his bhajana was mostly kīrtana. Rājarṣi Vanamālī Rāya sought his guidance. Died chanting the holy name in 1893, before his Deity Rādhā-vinoda; his son Gaura-bābu was with him.

fields.disappearance: 5 Āśvina 1702 Śaka (1780 CE), at Jofalāi (the record's text)
